blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III holds its final status conference ahead of the Nov. 30 trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte. The hearing will focus on key preparations for the trial, including the prosecution’s witness list and presentation of evidence, court schedules, defense security arrangements, and measures to protect witnesses and victims. Duterte will not attend after the chamber approved his waiver of his right to be present. The session will be livestreamed on the ICC’s website and social media accounts, with a 30-minute delay.
